title: Transfer geometry-only mutation beyond damped push
hypothesis: Restricting mutations to object–goal-relative contact geometry transfers useful approach bias to other bank structures more reliably than equally constrained gain-and-damping edits.

prediction.against: Matched gain-and-damping-only LLM mutations of the same parents
prediction.rationale: A five-point scope contrast tests a mechanism absent from generic mutation and bounds-only experiments; a separate positive comparison with unedited parents prevents declaring a less harmful edit useful. Requires per-idea GPU and LLM approval; stop the remote box afterward.

protocol.command: python scripts/stage_f.py mutation-scope-transfer --parents simple_reach_push_sharp_gate simple_reach_push_shared_gain --children-per-parent-scope 2 --fit-seeds 2920 2921 --probe-seed 2922 --heldout-seed 2923 --out-dir logs/research/geometry_transfer_s2920
code_changes: scripts/stage_f.py (mutation-scope-transfer: fittable-only code-only plan, 2 parents x 2 scopes x 2 draws, ITT fallbacks, matched contrasts)
lares/core/policy_generation.py (two-lane generator skips an empty exploration lane)

falsified_by: An upper paired 95% bound below +0.05 for geometry minus gain/damping refutes the predicted scope advantage. An upper bound at or below zero for geometry minus unedited parents refutes useful transfer. Zero-spanning intervals are inconclusive; ties are not improvements.

approval.note: approved by advisor gpt-6.1-sol (consult call_00015, 'revise' with changes applied) under the user's 2026-10-22 session delegation; 1600 episodes, 8 gpt-6.1-sol calls

controls.note: control is the matched gain-and-damping-only child (same parent, draw index and fit seed); the metric is already geometry minus control

result.notes: Two seed-bank parents (sharp_gate 0.98, shared_gain 0.62 fitted), two code-only scopes, two draws each; 8/8 children valid; fit seeds 2920/2921, probe s2922, confirmation s2923; ITT (no fallbacks needed). Geometry minus gain/damping -0.237 [-0.315, -0.160] (3/36/11); geometry minus parent -0.193 [-0.234, -0.151]; gain/damping minus parent +0.045 [-0.019, +0.109]. Three of four geometry children hurt their parent (sharp_gate draw 0: 0.54 vs 0.98; shared_gain draw 1: 0.27 vs 0.62); one matched it (sharp_gate draw 1: 1.00). Gain/damping edits on shared_gain improved it (0.82, 0.74 vs 0.62), on sharp_gate slightly lowered it (0.96, 0.86). Seeds barely matter (fits nearly identical across seeds). Caveats: the advisor's revision made both scopes code-only (no added parameters), whereas the D-004/D-006 geometry child added parameters; the two draws per scope came from one design call, so they are not independent LLM samples; 9 LLM calls vs 8 approved (one design call + eight implementations). 1600 episodes.

verdicts.reasoning: Geometry-only minus matched gain/damping-only children is -0.237 [-0.315, -0.160], 3/36/11, the opposite of the predicted +0.05; geometry children are also worse than their identically fitted parents, -0.193 [-0.234, -0.151], which refutes useful transfer by the predeclared rule (upper bound <= 0 against unedited parents). Three of four geometry children damaged a working controller. The D-004/D-006 benefit of the damped-push geometry child does not transfer to the reach-push family as code-only geometry edits; gain/damping edits were neutral to helpful (+0.045, interval spans zero), mainly on the weaker shared_gain parent.
verdicts.next_experiment: Do not generalise geometry-scope mutation; treat gen0_cand5_a0 as a single validated structure. The only consistent LLM win is structure-specific; next spend should be the cheap bank-admission check for gen0_cand5_a0, then consider gain/damping edits on the weakest bank member (shared_gain) as a small follow-up.

verdicts.reasoning: The named matched gain-and-damping control was measured: paired_success_difference was -0.2375, with a paired 95% interval of [-0.3149, -0.1601] [logs/research/geometry_transfer_s2920/summary.json]. The upper bound is below the predicted +0.05, refuting the scope advantage [logs/research/geometry_transfer_s2920/summary.json]. Geometry also underperformed unedited parents by -0.1925, with interval [-0.2339, -0.1511], meeting the separate falsification criterion for useful transfer [logs/research/geometry_transfer_s2920/summary.json]. Gain-and-damping mutations were not an established improvement over parents: their +0.045 contrast had a zero-spanning interval [-0.0195, +0.1095] and is inconclusive [logs/research/geometry_transfer_s2920/summary.json]. These conclusions apply to the tested children and parents, not to every possible mutation within either scope [logs/research/geometry_transfer_s2920/summary.json].
